description: Redraw this creature as clean premium pixel art in the house style of a polished creature-battler roster: compact readable pixel clusters, three or four tone ramps per material, one clear top-left light, a selective dark outline, and far less noisy texture. Raise readability: the dark body needs a crisp violet rim light along its back, legs and tail so it reads clearly against dark backgrounds, and clear muscle planes instead of murky smoke noise. Keep its identity exactly: a low prowling shadow panther, black-purple coat, a huge curved blade-shaped tail arching over its back, glowing magenta eyes, a thin eclipse-ring collar, wisps of smoke around the paws, right-facing three-quarter prowling pose. Same silhouette, pose and palette (black purple, deep violet, glowing magenta). Full body, transparent background, no ground shadow, no text.
